applies_to: REL16 ego pretrain dataset and R380-v2 real data. NOT C-old: C-old keeps the B1-old gripper contract unchanged.

real_source.signal: source LeRobot LEADER gripper action (follower measured width is NOT used for the label; sanity check only, ~91-93 % agreement)
real_source.note: same sign for HEAD and FRONT in R380

ego_source.consistency: matches the old C-old mapping raw = -270 * open_fraction with open when raw <= -135

per_dataset_signal.old_C8_259: ~/c8/grip/<tag>.npz field 'open_fraction' -- the exact field c8old_build_dataset.py used (state = -270 * open_fraction); per-session anchors already applied there
per_dataset_signal.HRL80: sensors.mcap /<side>/gripper 'normalized' (collector calibration gripper_v014: 0 closed .. 1 open) -- per-session anchors not needed

ego_source.parity_2026_09_28: PASS: 353,607 frames, range 0..1, p5 0.025 / p95 0.960, 4.2 % in [0.4, 0.6]; open share (>= 0.5) 17.2 % == C-old raw <= -135 share 17.2 % on the built c8old_train state

labeling: per future timestep independently: action[k, 9] (left) and action[k, 19] (right) are the binary intent of that future frame; never one label per segment

deploy.note: the jaw may stop on the cube (seen left -89 / right -128) while the semantic target stays CLOSE = 0

rel16_ego_state76: cross-arm (wrt) terms use the robot-frame geometry produced by the chosen robot seed pair of the TR master (ego has no shared L/R human frame); 50.05 ms history and 16 x 50.05 ms future cut usable rows out of each 65-frame segment
c_old_ego: measured EEF C/D aux targets recomputed from the master's final selected trajectory (T_tgt anchored at the chosen seed)
